meta.author:
詞、曲 Brooke Fraser
中譯詞 City Harvest Church

lines.b: I see the King of glory
Coming on the clouds with fire

lines.a: 全地震動 全地震動
lines.b: The whole earth shakes
I see His love and mercy
Washing over all our sin

lines.a: 萬民歌唱 萬民歌唱
lines.b: The people sing
Hosanna Hosanna
Hosanna in the highest
Hosanna Hosanna
Hosanna in the highest
I see a generation
Rising up to take their place

lines.a: 放下自己 放下自己
lines.b: With selfless faith
I see a near revival
Stirring as we pray and seek

lines.a: 我們屈膝 我們屈膝
lines.b: We're on our knees
Heal my heart and make it clean

lines.a: 開啟我雙眼看見你心意
lines.b: Open up my eyes to the things unseen

lines.a: 教我如何能愛你的百姓
lines.b: Show me how to love like You have loved me
Break my heart for what breaks Yours

lines.a: 我所做一切全為你旨意
lines.b: Everything I am for Your Kingdom's cause

lines.a: 一生追求你直到天地廢去
lines.b: As I walk from earth into eternity
